pre_condition: layers_spec is a non-empty string containing either a single non-negative integer, or two non-negative integers joined by a hyphen '-'.
post_condition: Returns a (start, end) tuple of two ints forming an inclusive range. When the input contains no hyphen, start equals end equals the integer value parsed from the input. When the input contains a hyphen, start is the integer parsed from the substring before the first hyphen and end is the integer parsed from the substring after the first hyphen. Leading and trailing whitespace on the input and around each hyphen-delimited part is stripped before parsing. Raises ValueError when the parsed start value exceeds the parsed end value.
